**Finding submitted: deviation (AUDIT).**

- **Problem:** § 22.1 (p0093) allows Vendor to audit us "at any time without notice" with remote access to our systems — unlimited frequency, no notice, and system access, all of which sit in the rule's walk-away territory.
- **Mitigants already present:** § 22.2 meets the preferred cost split (Vendor pays unless underpayment exceeds 5%) and bars direct system/unrelated-data access; § 22.3 makes findings our Confidential Information. So no change was needed there.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** rewrote 22.1 to permit one audit per twelve-month period, on 30 days' prior written notice, during business hours without unreasonable disruption, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, conducted off-site via records we provide, with the remote-access language deleted. Comment offers 15 days' notice as a fallback.
